Synopsis:
BofA's co-head of investment banking, Mike Joo (20-year veteran), is departing for an external opportunity. The bank has seen several senior exits recently but has offset this with 40+ new MD hires into GCIB. Faiz Ahmad and Karim Assef will co-lead global IB going forward. Context: BofA is ranked 4th globally in IB revenue (Dealogic), beat Q2 estimates on record trading and IB strength, and M&A activity hit record H1 2026 levels driven by mega-deals ($10B+).
